scope: Offline position evaluation, immediate branch comparison and scored AI advice

checks.real_engine: Bundled NNUE returns a legal recommendation and displayable score; cancellation still passes
controlled_callback_checks: Black scores and upper/lower bounds normalize to Red; mate distance is separate
Missing depth is not a zero score; stalemate awards the opponent the win; draws are explicit
Current position is evaluated before open branches; explicit AI advice preempts background work
Branch analysis uses immediate child positions, including when a saved line continues further
Red prefers higher Red scores and Black prefers lower Red scores within the compared group
Evaluation neither changes the current node nor adds or reorders branches
Node cache survives navigation and board orientation changes
Independent switches persist; scored AI advice works with both switches off
Closing comparison, changing node or budget, editing setup and leaving reject late results
Bounds and failed analyses do not produce exact gaps; failures require an explicit retry
checks.existing_checks: Legal moves, chosen branches, editor selection/undo, JSON restore, draft validation, rename/setup editing and safe capture hints also pass

visual_review.source: Actual SwiftUI views with scores from finite bundled Pikafish searches, not static score fixtures
reviewed_states: Compact current-position score with all primary board controls visible
AI recommendation score with separate adopt action
Ordinary branch scores with upper/lower bounds
Mate-distance branch scores in a native iOS medium sheet
Evaluation detail with scrollable explanations and a visible retry action
visual_review.native_simulator: Debug study and branch entry points launched and captured; actual asynchronous scores complete while the comparison sheet is open

storage_and_network: Evaluation cache is session-only, JSON format is unchanged, and no remote API calls are made

advice_control_regression.reproduced_before_fix: CHECK_FAILED: An advice failure must not pause the opponent's AI
advice_control_regression.change: Only failures of automatic move searches pause AI control; advice failures preserve the existing state
advice_control_regression.builds: macOS, unsigned iOS and iOS Simulator passed
checks: Red and Black human turns: requesting and completing advice neither plays a move nor pauses the opponent's AI
Adopting advice, choosing another move, or moving before advice finishes starts the automatic opponent reply
Stopping advice or failing to obtain it preserves control and ignores late advice
An already paused control state remains paused; stopping or failing an automatic move still pauses control
With current evaluation enabled, advice preemption and old evaluation callbacks do not interrupt automatic replies
advice_control_regression.normal_advice_path: No pause reproduced in controlled session callbacks for a successful advice request; native button taps have not been replayed

limitations: Offscreen rendering and launch captures do not verify native taps, dragging, haptics or navigation gestures
Physical-device memory, battery usage and system suspension behavior have not been measured
Finite search scores and same-budget branch gaps are estimates, not win probabilities or proofs of overall optimality
